extension.description: Build literature reviews for the social sciences with an AI agent: search Semantic Scholar and OpenAlex, screen candidates, and check citations — from the sidebar.
view.surveys.name: Surveys
welcome.noWorkspace:
Prior Work keeps each literature review in a workspace: a folder (and a private Git repository) with the reports and their state.
[Create a Workspace](command:priorwork.initWorkspace)
Already have one? Open its folder.
[Open Folder](command:vscode.openFolder)
[Diagnose the Setup](command:priorwork.doctor)
welcome.legacy:
This folder is a workspace of lit, Prior Work's former name. Move it to the new layout first (your reports and decisions are kept).
[Move to Prior Work](command:priorwork.migrate)
welcome.noSurveys:
No surveys yet.
[Start a Survey](command:priorwork.newSurvey)
Set your API keys first for faster searches.
[Open .env](command:priorwork.openEnv)
command.migrate: Move a lit Workspace to Prior Work
config.command: The `priorwork` command. Empty: the workspace's `.venv`, then `priorwork` on `PATH`.
config.python: The Python used to create a workspace's `.venv`. Empty: `python3` (`py -3` on Windows).
config.autoAdvance: After a decision on the paper page, move on to the next unscreened paper.
walkthrough.title: Get Started with Prior Work
walkthrough.description: Set up a workspace and screen your first papers.
walkthrough.workspace.title: Create a workspace
walkthrough.workspace.description:
A workspace is a folder that holds your reports and the state of each survey. Keep it in a private GitHub repository.
[Create a Workspace](command:priorwork.initWorkspace)
walkthrough.keys.title: Set your API keys
walkthrough.keys.description:
A free Semantic Scholar API key makes searches much faster; Zotero is optional.
[Open .env](command:priorwork.openEnv)
walkthrough.survey.title: Start a survey
walkthrough.survey.description:
Give the topic, an English slug and the depth (quick or full).
[New Survey](command:priorwork.newSurvey)
walkthrough.screen.title: Search and screen
walkthrough.screen.description:
Search in English, then include, hold or exclude each candidate on the paper page (keys I, M, X).
[Screen Candidates](command:priorwork.screen)
walkthrough.agent.title: Work with your agent
walkthrough.agent.description: The workspace carries AGENTS.md and skills (/survey-new, /survey-screen, /survey-extract, /survey-check) for Claude Code and other agents. The agent fills in the paper cards and writes the review; the sidebar follows its changes.
